strongest_angle: Comparing the physical limits and intellectual feats of Arthur Conan Doyle's detective Sherlock Holmes at 221B Baker Street against Bram Stoker's Count Dracula from Castle Dracula using verified literary citations.

key_facts.fact: Count Dracula possesses physical strength equivalent to twenty strong men according to Van Helsing in Bram Stoker's novel.
Sherlock Holmes resides at 221B Baker Street and utilizes deductive reasoning and observation as his primary skills against various mysteries.
Count Dracula inhabits Castle Dracula located in the Carpathian Mountains and can assume the form of an animal.
Draconian physical abilities include crawling on castle walls with his cloak spreading behind him like the wings of a monstrous bat during encounters in Chapter 18.
